# External Lean source catalog

Derived from the frozen compiled graph and 464-unit supplier inventory. Exact declarations, kinds, complete names, source hashes and selected-source records are in [catalog.json.gz](catalog.json.gz); source/license/pin receipts and output digests are in [metadata.json](metadata.json). The graph remains authoritative for individual dependency edges. Regenerate these documentation files with `python3 docs/navigation/external/generate.py`; this uses only checked-in inputs, without Lean or network access. Check deterministic regeneration with `python3 docs/navigation/external/generate.py --check` and local links with `python3 docs/navigation/external/validate.py`.

The verified scientific snapshot is [`theorem-1.8-verified`](https://github.com/lazyinspirit/artin-tits-normalisers-lean/tree/theorem-1.8-verified), commit `3c389334729dbd37d26bdf52dd808e540aae6d37`. [Clean CI 43599459363](https://github.com/lazyinspirit/artin-tits-normalisers-lean/actions/runs/43599459363) and its [permanent source-bound archive](../../theorem18/landmarks/github-evidence/run-43599459363/README.md) passed. The [closeout](../../theorem18/landmarks/milestone5-closeout.json) proves full Theorem 1.8 and actual arrangement asphericity. It does not assert actual universal-cover contractibility or a two-sided nerve homotopy equivalence.

Reachability means actual compiled type/value/structural references, not imports. Counts include generated and private declarations. A source-file link is not a claim that every declaration in that file is used. The two graphs of selected import closure and term dependencies are distinct.

## leanprover/lean4

Exact revision: [`b35cb10cf2ced51a2fd1880cfdbf75c71ab7a35a`](https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/tree/b35cb10cf2ced51a2fd1880cfdbf75c71ab7a35a). Lean compiler/kernel, Init and Std foundations; Lean/Lake build SDK.

Actual dependency declarations: **7,244** (4,323 theorems, 2,339 definitions, 582 other); **145** defining modules. Observed imported modules: 2007; this is not a proof-use count.

License: [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/blob/b35cb10cf2ced51a2fd1880cfdbf75c71ab7a35a/LICENSE). Exact license URLs, preserved license hashes and cohort evidence are in the machine repository record.

## Interpretation and verification limits

Finite.equivFin.congr_simp is a project root with canonical mathlib source attribution due to an audited identical physical theorem occurrence. It is recorded separately, not inflated into the non-root external count.

Official kernel checks/replays are relative to their imported pinned contexts. This catalog does not assert that all of Lean, mathlib or build packages were freshly independently reviewed or replayed.

The three previously accepted Colib modules reused by the latest cohort are not counted again. Upstream comments attributing an implementation origin to Quillen remain provenance notes; the imported pinned implementation is Colib. No fourth scientific supplier repository is inferred from those comments.
